doc: Reason codes (AWR-17 §8). Codes never change meaning; only additions. Ranges and module sub-ranges follow AWR-17 §8.1 and §8.4. D2 adds 500-599 (AWR-04 §11.3, AWR-17 §17.9): codes 500-599 are unrelated to HTTP 5xx. D3 adds 600-699 (AWR-05 §8.4, AWR-17 §18.12; d1 = V0.3): world, event, physics, sensor, agent and bench sub-ranges; 606-610, 622-629, 653-660, 668-679 and 699 are reserved. Agent WS close codes 4460 and 4462-4464 (4461 reserved).

ranges.owner: trusted entry, producer admission, planning precheck
M19 (sensor range shared with M13, registered by M19)

reasons.name: TARGET_PLACEMENT_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 识别物放置位置无效
reasons.remedy_zh: 在可通行地面或屋顶重新放置

reasons.name: SOUND_PARAM_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 声源参数越界或组合无效

reasons.name: SENSITIVITY_PARAM_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 敏感体参数越界或超过 4 个

reasons.name: TARGET_NOT_FOUND
reasons.message_zh: 命令载荷引用的识别物不存在

reasons.name: MOTION_PARAM_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 运动参数越界（路径点数、速度、转向率、游走区域）

reasons.name: SENSOR_UNSUPPORTED
reasons.message_zh: 该机型不能挂载或不具备该传感器

reasons.name: SENSOR_PARAM_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 传感器参数越界（焦距、分辨率需要机载算力等）

reasons.name: LEVEL_UNREACHABLE
reasons.message_zh: 会话中没有传感器能达到所需等级
reasons.remedy_zh: 降低 level_req 或挂载成像传感器

reasons.name: ILLUMINATOR_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 外挂照明器要求开启而该机未挂载
reasons.remedy_zh: 挂载 nir_ill_l 或改用机内照明

reasons.name: FIELD_QUERY_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 场指标、锚点或采样数非法

reasons.name: TASK_INFEASIBLE
reasons.message_zh: 任务不可行

reasons.name: NO_FEASIBLE_STATION
reasons.message_zh: 可行窗口为空，没有满足不被发现与所需等级的站位
reasons.remedy_zh: 按 detail.suggestions 换型、加照明器或长焦热像、缩小敏感范围

reasons.name: NEST_EMPTY
reasons.message_zh: 允许的机巢中没有可用机体
reasons.remedy_zh: 添加无人机或放宽允许机巢

reasons.name: KEEPOUT_VIOLATION
reasons.message_zh: 航段或站位进入禁入体
reasons.remedy_zh: 调整几何或等待重规划

reasons.name: PLAN_REJECTED
reasons.message_zh: 外部分配计划未通过可行性检查
reasons.remedy_zh: 按 detail.violations 逐项修改计划

reasons.name: PLAN_INPUT_TOO_LARGE
reasons.message_zh: 规划输入超过规模配额
reasons.remedy_zh: 缩小区域、减少顶点或放宽 GSD

reasons.name: PLAN_THROTTLED
reasons.message_zh: 10 min 内 3 次规划超时，规划冻结 5 min

reasons.name: WORLD_UNCALIBRATED
reasons.message_zh: 世界不满足米制标定，不得加载事件

reasons.name: WORLD_BUILD_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 世界构建失败

reasons.name: WORLD_LICENSE_MISSING
reasons.message_zh: 许可、署名或派生来源字段缺失

reasons.name: WORLD_REGISTRATION_REJECTED
reasons.message_zh: 配准门限未通过或配准记录缺失、未接受
reasons.remedy_zh: 补充控制点或重新配准

reasons.name: GEOSVC_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 共享几何服务不可达或超时

reasons.name: GEOSVC_BINDING_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 客户端与服务的世界版本或坐标绑定不一致

reasons.name: EVENT_COMPILE_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 门 1 或吸附失败

reasons.name: EVENT_INFEASIBLE
reasons.message_zh: 门 2 不可行
reasons.remedy_zh: 采纳建议时刻或调整锚点

reasons.name: EVENT_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: strict 下声明或关系不成立

reasons.name: TAPE_HASH_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 磁带内容哈希不一致

reasons.name: TAPE_WORLD_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 磁带与世界版本、网格或 NavMesh 不一致

reasons.name: EVENT_NAVMESH_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 世界包缺少所需 profile 的 NavMesh

reasons.name: EVENT_VERSION_FROZEN
reasons.message_zh: 修改已发布或已被引用的版本

reasons.name: EVENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 超出事件限额（演员、时长、文本体积）

reasons.name: EVENT_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 当前阶段不支持的模式、类别或动作

reasons.name: TAPE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED
reasons.message_zh: 磁带魔数、schema 或编解码版本不受支持

reasons.name: EVENT_DRAFT_CONFLICT
reasons.message_zh: 草稿 ETag 不一致

reasons.name: PHYSICS_TIER_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 物理档未启用、未交付或不支持该构型与机数

reasons.name: GZ_NOT_READY
reasons.message_zh: gz 实例启动或就绪屏障超时

reasons.name: GZ_STEP_TIMEOUT
reasons.message_zh: 单 tick 等待 step_done 超时

reasons.name: SITL_NOT_RANKED
reasons.message_zh: SITL 运行进入排名或 test 提交

reasons.name: POSE_HISTORY_OVERFLOW
reasons.message_zh: 无损位姿缓冲将覆盖未释放样本

reasons.name: PHYS_PROTOCOL_ERROR
reasons.message_zh: gz 控制协议版本、序号或负载错误

reasons.name: GZ_EXPORT_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: SDF 导出自动验收未通过

reasons.name: PHYS_CLOCK_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 时钟档与输出不相容或 tick 不是物理步长整数倍

reasons.name: GZ_INSTANCE_EXITED
reasons.message_zh: gz 或 PX4 进程异常退出

reasons.name: SITL_LINK_LOST
reasons.message_zh: MAVLink 心跳丢失

reasons.name: SENSOR_SESSION_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 传感器会话不存在、已关闭或协议不兼容

reasons.name: SENSOR_BACKPRESSURE
reasons.message_zh: 传感器服务在途超限（Benchmark 下阻塞仿真时钟，不降频）

reasons.name: SENSOR_CONTRACT_VIOLATION
reasons.message_zh: 请求或输出违反契约（含 SLAM 合同测试失败）

reasons.name: APPEARANCE_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 外观层不存在或未通过配准验收

reasons.name: OBS_SCHEMA_VIOLATION
reasons.message_zh: bench/obs.v1 投影失败（运行中止）

reasons.name: SENSOR_WORLD_LOAD_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 世界包缺失、损坏或缺少传感器侧表

reasons.name: SENSOR_POSE_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 请求时刻超出已推进的位姿历史（禁止外推）

reasons.name: SENSOR_GPU_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 无可用 GPU 或显存

reasons.name: SENSOR_WORKER_LOST
reasons.message_zh: 传感器 Worker 失联或帧看门狗超时

reasons.name: SENSOR_RIG_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: rig 或输出组合不合法

reasons.name: SENSOR_DYNAMIC_SOURCE_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 磁带或世界版本与会话声明不一致

reasons.name: SENSOR_ASSET_LICENSE_MISSING
reasons.message_zh: 动态实体资产无许可登记

reasons.name: SENSOR_DETERMINISM_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 复核运行帧摘要与基准不一致

reasons.name: AGENT_TIMEOUT
reasons.message_zh: Agent 未在墙钟预算内返回动作
reasons.remedy_zh: 缩短决策时间或声明决策时延

reasons.name: OBS_LEVEL_FORBIDDEN
reasons.message_zh: 观测档不允许用于该运行类型

reasons.name: ACTION_REJECTED
reasons.message_zh: 动作项被拒

reasons.name: AGENT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION
reasons.message_zh: 隔离条件不满足（排名运行使用 SDK 或进程内 Agent 等）

reasons.name: AGENT_CRASHED
reasons.message_zh: Agent 退出、握手超时或连接中断超出宽限

reasons.name: AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR
reasons.message_zh: 帧格式、长度、解码、版本或 k 不一致

reasons.name: COMM_MESSAGE_REJECTED
reasons.message_zh: 消息超长、主题超长、目的方不存在或通信关闭

reasons.name: RUN_STATE_CONFLICT
reasons.message_zh: 当前状态不允许该操作

reasons.name: RUN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 运行配额或队列上限

reasons.name: RUN_SPEC_INVALID
reasons.message_zh: 运行规格校验未通过

reasons.name: RUN_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.message_zh: 计算资源不可用

reasons.name: SLAM_JOB_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: SLAM 作业异常结束（含 OOM）

reasons.name: STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 存储配额不足

reasons.name: WRITE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 写带宽达到预算，暂缓准入

reasons.name: RECORDING_INTEGRITY_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 录制完整性校验未通过

reasons.name: EVALUATION_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 评测失败（录制保留）

reasons.name: BENCH_EXPORT_FAILED
reasons.message_zh: 导出作业失败

reasons.name: PUBLIC_READ_ONLY
reasons.message_zh: 公开站为只读视图

reasons.name: TEST_SPLIT_ACCESS_DENIED
reasons.message_zh: 无权访问测试集数据

reasons.name: SUBMISSION_REJECTED
reasons.message_zh: 提交未通过边界或镜像检查

reasons.name: RUN_WALL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 运行超过墙钟上限

reasons.name: RERUN_VERSION_MISMATCH
reasons.message_zh: 录制的 Rerun 版本与服务不一致

reasons.name: SEED_ACCESS_DENIED
reasons.message_zh: 无权查看排名运行种子

reasons.name: PUBLISH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
reasons.message_zh: 静态制品超出磁盘或单文件预算

reasons.name: ARTIFACT_EXPIRED
reasons.message_zh: 录制或派生物已按保留策略清理

reasons.name: FRAME_REQUEST_LIMIT
reasons.message_zh: 帧区间请求超出帧数或字节上限

ws_close_codes.name: PROTOCOL_ERROR
ws_close_codes.client: reconnect; FATAL after 3 in a row

ws_close_codes.name: ABNORMAL
ws_close_codes.client: GET /api/auth/whoami to tell 401 from 403, else reconnect

ws_close_codes.name: SANDBOX_GONE
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; drop the stored sandbox session; show the end dialog (error 305, 503, 506 or 510 precedes the close)

ws_close_codes.name: IDLE_RECLAIMED
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; enter the power-saving overlay, reconnect (viewer) or resume (sandbox) after an interaction

ws_close_codes.name: VIEWER_SEATS_FULL
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; join the viewer queue (R81), reconnect on seat_ready

ws_close_codes.name: RUN_ENDED
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; the SDK ends the episode

ws_close_codes.name: AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; the SDK raises ProtocolError

ws_close_codes.name: AGENT_SUPERSEDED
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; another connection took over the agent

ws_close_codes.name: AGENT_NOT_ACCEPTED
ws_close_codes.client: do not reconnect; check policy.kind and the run state
